provenance.summary: Illustrative placeholder parameters, NOT fitted to experimental data and NOT taken from any publication. They exist only so that the gamma-phi flash path, the CLI --flash-mode gamma-phi option and the examples have a runnable default. Do not use them for engineering work or cite them as physical parameters.
provenance.history: Added ad hoc in commits e5ccd8f (Methane/Ethane) and ecd476e (Benzene/Water); no source was recorded at the time and none has been identified since.
provenance.how_to_use_real_parameters: Build NRTLParameters.from_pairs(...) with your own fitted or literature values and pass it as NRTL(parameters=...). For a citation-backed published example see tests/fixtures/nrtl/tessier2000_problem1.json.
provenance.note: Keys outside 'schema_version', 'model' and 'pairs' (and extra keys inside a pair entry) are documentation only; the loader ignores them, so recording provenance does not require a schema bump.

pairs.source_note: Illustrative placeholder, not fitted data. A near-ideal light-alkane pair would in practice have gamma very close to 1.
